title: Mirage F1EE (DCS)

sources.title: DCS Mirage F1 Quick Start Guide (EN)

intro: The Mirage F1EE is the multi-role version of the Mirage F1 that can take fuel in flight. Most of the cockpit is the same as in the F1CE, and this guide only lists what differs: a new navigation indicator, an inertial navigation system, a radar warning receiver with its own screen and the aerial refuelling system.

panels.name: Radar detector indicator
panels.text: A small display that warns the pilot when an enemy radar is looking at the plane.
panels.context: It is the BF radar detector (an RWR, a radar warning receiver). It gives a light and sound warning from every direction and shows what kind of radar it is.

controls.name: Jammer detection / feeder tanks overflow light
controls.text: A light with two jobs. It comes on when the radar detector senses a jammer, a transmitter that blinds radars. It also warns that the feeder tanks are overflowing while fuel is taken from a tanker in the air, but only when the refuelling system is switched on.
controls.context: The manual says the overflow function is not implemented in the game. The light sits below the standby compass and can be pressed to test it.

panels.name: Jettison panel
panels.text: The buttons that let the pilot drop the external loads (tanks, bombs, rockets) or fire the wingtip missiles unarmed, in an emergency.
panels.context: Dropping the loads makes the plane lighter and faster. The buttons are guarded so they are not pressed by accident.

controls.name: MATRA 550 or Sidewinder jettison button (catalog only)
controls.text: The catalog lists a guarded button on the main panel that launches the two wingtip missiles unarmed. The game's F1EE cockpit offers no clickable part for it.
controls.context: On the F1CE this button is described with its guard in the jettison panel.

panels.name: Navigation indicator (IDN)
panels.text: The round navigation dial of the main panel. The F1EE uses the newer version described in the panel 'Navigation indicator (IDN, F1EE)'.
panels.context: The extra switches of the F1CE dial are not present on the F1EE; the new dial uses its own panel items.

controls.name: Navigation indicator (IDN)
controls.text: The round navigation dial in the middle of the panel. On the F1EE it is the newer version with a compass rose, a wide needle, a narrow needle and a distance counter, and it also works with the inertial navigation system.
controls.context: The parts of this dial are listed in the panel 'Navigation indicator (IDN, F1EE)'. The mode selector, test button and vector switches of the F1CE version do not exist here.

panels.name: Warning horn, probe heat and radar detector switches
panels.text: Three switches for safety equipment: the warning horn, the heating of the speed probes and the radar detector.
panels.context: The after-start list switches on all three.

controls.name: Radar detector switch

positions.name: OFF
positions.text: The radar warning system is off.

positions.name: ON
positions.text: The radar warning system is on.

controls.text: Switches on the radar warning system. The game names it 'Radar detector switch'. On the F1EE the warning system can be the BF radar detector or the AN/ALR-300 receiver, depending on the mission setting.
controls.context: The manual says the ALR-300 has a power switch on the front part of the right console. The after-start list sets the switch ON.
